collection.credit: NEW EVENTS — INNER LIFE, PART VII (121-140, draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)

ledger.why: the casting line (the roles carry it)

collection.description: A villager wants to fix their own roof alone, and a very kind friend keeps coming over to help.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (subject) is fixing (subject.his/her) own roof. (subject.He/She) wants to do it alone, with no help, to prove (subject.he/she) can. (friend), who is very kind, keeps coming over to help. (friend.He/She) holds the ladder. (friend.He/She) hands up leaves. (friend.He/She) suggests a better knot. (subject) is starting to grind (subject.his/her) teeth.

a.name: Answer A
a.text: "I really appreciate it," (subject) says, "but I want to do this one by myself." (friend) blinks, then smiles. "Of course. Shout if you need me." (friend.He/She) sits a little way off and doesn't help at all. When (subject) finishes, the roof is a little lumpy, and entirely (subject.his/her) own. (friend) is the first to admire it.

b.name: Answer B
b.text: (subject) sighs and lets (friend) help. Together they finish in half the time, and the roof is very good. (subject) is grateful, and also a tiny bit annoyed, and decides both of those are allowed. Next time, (subject.he/she) thinks, (subject.he/she) might mention it before (friend) shows up with the ladder.
